UPDATE projects SET
            storage_backend    = $2,
            storage_ciphertext = $3,
            storage_nonce      = $4,
            dek_ciphertext     = $5,
            dek_nonce          = $6,
            kek_version        = $7,
            updated_at         = now()
        WHERE id = $1 AND revoked_at IS NULL
